description: Quetta Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 29 January 1970 and is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of yarn and fabric. It runs a vertically integrated spinning and weaving operation with 73,488 spindles, 1,104 rotors and 250 Tsudakoma air-jet looms backed by a Benninger back process, producing ring-spun and open-end yarns and woven fabric for the garment and home-textile industries. Fabric is woven up to 76 inches wide, with six-colour dobby looms for yarn-dyed qualities, and the company puts annual fabric production at 70 million metres.

products.name: Speciality yarns
products.summary: Organic cotton, Tencel, bamboo, regenerated-cotton, slub and compact yarns, which the company lists among its products.

products.name: Woven fabric
products.summary: Fabric from 250 Tsudakoma air-jet looms up to 76 inches wide — stretch twills and satins, custom designs, double-face fabrics and moleskins — for the apparel market, plus yarn-dyed fabrics from six-colour dobby looms.
